(1) A suspect who has been arrested and detained
by a police officer in terms of this Act, shall be produced
before  any  Magistrate  not  later  than  forty  eight  hours
following the arrest:
Provided however, where the arrest has been carried out,
outside the territory of the Republic of Sri Lanka or on board
any aircraft or vessel, the period of time necessary for the
journey from place of arrest to the relevant Magistrate shall
be excluded in calculating such forty eight hours.

Magistrate–
